theme_and_archetype.description: An institutional-grade, information-dense dark trading terminal. Balances high-speed readability with configurable workspaces. Complexity is concealed but accessible. Avoids generic crypto neon aesthetics in favor of authoritative, prestige-coded data display.

rules.headings: Chivo, sans-serif. Tracking tight. Never centered.
rules.prices_and_data: JetBrains Mono, monospace. Mandatory for all numbers, prices, percentages, and tickers to ensure vertical alignment and institutional feel.

layout_and_spacing.description: Density, Data Correlation, Scanability. Every pixel utilized. Minimal gaps, high information density.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black font-bold font-mono text-sm uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm hover:bg-[#F3CE56] transition-colors px-4 py-2
buttons.buy: bg-transparent border border-[#00B86B] text-[#00B86B] font-mono hover:bg-[#00B86B] hover:text-white transition-colors
buttons.sell: bg-transparent border border-[#FF2A55] text-[#FF2A55] font-mono hover:bg-[#FF2A55] hover:text-white transition-colors
buttons.timeframe_tab: text-xs font-mono px-3 py-1 text-gray-400 hover:text-white data-[state=active]:bg-[#262626] data-[state=active]:text-[#D4AF37] rounded-sm transition-all

tables.header: text-xs font-mono text-gray-500 uppercase border-b border-[#262626] pb-2 text-left

badges.ai_confidence: px-2 py-1 bg-[#D4AF37]/10 text-[#D4AF37] border border-[#D4AF37]/30 font-mono text-xs rounded-sm
badges.sentiment_bull: px-2 py-1 bg-[#00B86B]/10 text-[#00B86B] font-mono text-xs rounded-sm
badges.sentiment_bear: px-2 py-1 bg-[#FF2A55]/10 text-[#FF2A55] font-mono text-xs rounded-sm

motion_and_interaction.philosophy: Execution-focused. No decorative animations. Zero layout shift.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Instant or 150ms ease-out transitions. Focus on highlighting active data rows.
motion_and_interaction.data_updates: Price ticks should flash slightly (green for up-tick, red for down-tick) then fade to normal color within 500ms.
motion_and_interaction.loading: Use mono-spaced ASCII style loaders or simple linear progress bars at the top of panels.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast ratios are met. Text on dark background must be at least #A3A3A3.

media.background_texture_usage: Use as a very low opacity (5%) overlay on the AI signal card or header to give a subtle premium gold/dark texture.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install JetBrains Mono and Chivo fonts.
Do not use generic Shadcn rounded-lg or rounded-xl borders. Override everything to rounded-sm or rounded-none.
Ensure all price data is rendered using the 'mono' font family for vertical alignment.
Build the dashboard using a CSS Grid structure with minimal gaps (gap-1 or gap-2) to maximize screen real estate.
For the Chart, use a robust charting library like lightweight-charts (TradingView) or Recharts customized for candlesticks.
For the AI Signal Card, prominently display the reasoning, confidence score, Entry, TP, and SL. Use the gold accent color to highlight AI-driven insights.
MANDATORY: Add `data-testid` attributes to all buttons, tabs, and critical data points.
